announce_contract: Cron announce fallback delivers final text only if a non-empty payload remains after silent-reply normalization.
no_reply_contract: Exact NO_REPLY is a silent token: normalizeSilentReplyText returns text undefined; deliverViaDirect/finalizeTextDelivery finish as silent with delivered=false/not-delivered.
telegram_boundary: No Telegram send is attempted when normalized payloads are empty; target resolution can be ok while delivered=false.
